limits: No universal bug-free claim; static 14-module/366-route inventory is not exhaustive behavior coverage.
Two clinical rubric mismatches and ten unapproved teaching references remain; no clinical content/historical score rewrite.
Existing unrecorded-result normal assumption and optional other-university demo rubric fallback need separate review.
Only ARAK automatic target; no silent university creation. Missing rubric/catalog overflow causes atomic rollback plus startup warning. Retired/inactive identities are not resurrected.
No external AI/provider grading test or clinical sign-off; local recorded results/offline replies only.
No real-teacher usability study, screen reader test, exhaustive contrast test or every form mutation.
Prior legacy-flat-file ownership limitations and CSV spreadsheet/re-save caveats remain.
test_corrections: An early fixture tried to insert competitive VP; existing schema correctly rejected it, so the positive fixture now asserts the prohibition rather than bypassing it.
Media fixture explicitly inserts its source chart because repeated seed --force preserves tombstones; no production assertions weakened.
Mobile tab test initially forgot the designed collapsed-navigation toggle.
An optional student screenshot timed out; the UI order assertions were rerun successfully without relying on screenshot output.
